design.name: 玄冰巨蟹
design.brief: A giant armoured ice crab of the frozen sea, the tank: a huge low crab about 4 m wide with a thick dark ink-blue carapace crusted with sea ice and barnacles, one enormous flat crusher claw held in front of its face like a wall of armour and one smaller cutting claw, eight jointed walking legs, small stalked eyes; a glowing aqua-cyan vent gap at the back of its shell where the carapace meets the abdomen (weak spot, behind it). Sideways-walking, stubborn, heavy.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes. Its defence is its own giant claw and shell: it holds NO shield and NO weapon.
design.turnaround_pose: standing on its eight walking legs, body level, all eight legs spread evenly and planted with gaps of air between them; the huge crusher claw and the smaller cutting claw both held CLOSED in front of the face, symmetric height; eyes on stalks up; the back vent between carapace and abdomen painted as opaque aqua-cyan (no halo)
design.turnaround_digits: all eight legs and both claws fully inside the frame and clearly separated; in the side views the whole width must fit inside the view with margin.
